# chukdoo_core (vendored)

Source of truth: `chukdoo/packages/chukdoo_core` in the chukdoo repository
(vendored at chukdoo commit 9f5f90d). Do not edit this copy. Change the
package in chukdoo, run its tests there (`dart test`), then copy `lib/` and
`pubspec.yaml` here again (without `dev_dependencies`).

chuk_chat uses it for the built-in Chukdoo connector: device pairing
(`PairingClient`), the stored credentials (`ChukdooCredentials`) and the tool
layer (`ChukdooTools`). See `docs/MCP_CONNECTORS.md` (section "Chukdoo") and
chukdoo's `docs/AI_ACCESS.md`.
